pr.title: Put a pull request drawer's GitHub and Projector links on one line
pr.head: 2143ba693b8b1934ef6572b5ac9d938aa51c6853

summary: Projector's panel lists the pull requests a Claude Code session fixes or reviews, one line each, above the prompt. Clicking a pull request's number opens a drawer under it: a line of facts, the Discuss and Dismiss actions, links to the pull request, and a line for each unresolved review thread.

#397 put the two actions on one line. The two links, open in github and open in projector, still took a line each, because a terminal that does not draw hyperlinks prints a link's URL after its text, and a shared line leaves less room for the URL. This change puts both links on one line under the actions, two columns apart, as the actions are. The pull request body accepts that a terminal without hyperlinks now prints both URLs on that line.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
• The Projector review of 2143ba6 requests changes for one finding: the drawer's code comment lost its reason and now only describes the layout beneath it.
  • It also suggests saying "the links" rather than "the two links" in docs/plugins.md, and testing the row for a pull request without a summary link.

cards.title: Terms
cards.html:
• Drawer: the lines the panel opens under a pull request when you click its number.
  • Summary link: the Projector summary URL that the pull request's description links, which the panel reads as summaryUrl.
  • Focus ring: the highlight that Tab moves between the panel's lines and actions when the panel has the keyboard.

groups.title: The drawer draws its two links in one row
groups.kicker: The drawer's links move from a line each into one row, with a test and the docs
intro: In hooks/register.tsx, the pull request drawer drew each link as a Markdown element of its own in the drawer's column, so each took a line. The change wraps both in a Box keyed links:<key> with flexDirection="row" and columnGap={2}, the same spacing that drawActions gives the action row. The open in projector link still appears only when the description links a summary, so a pull request without one shows only open in github on that line.
The links take no press and no hotkey: the terminal opens them as it opens any link. So the focus ring and the 7, 8, and 9 hotkeys work as before.

checks.text: With hooks/register.tsx reverted to main, the drawer test fails, listing github:x/y#7 and projector:x/y#7 where it expects links:x/y#7. At this head, the full gate passes, including claude plugin test . and hooks/typecheck.sh.

files.note: Wraps the two link elements in the links: row and rewrites the comment above the actions.

checks.text: The comment lost the reason it carried and now only describes the layout that the drawActions call and the links: Box beneath it already show. The repository's code guidelines forbid a comment that narrates the code below it. Delete the comment, or give a reason a maintainer cannot read from the code.
The test kit does not lay out text, so no run measured how this row wraps on a narrow terminal or in a terminal without hyperlinks, which prints both URLs on it.
When summaryUrl is null, the row holds only github:. A temporary test that opened the drawer of o/r#1, which has no summary link, passed at this head.

files.note: The drawer test expects the facts, the actions: row, the links: row, and the thread lines, in that order, and checks that the links: row is a row with a gap of 2 holding github: and then projector:.
Shows both links on one line in the drawer example, says they follow the actions side by side, and drops the paragraph that gave each link a line of its own.
